dedupe_keys.name: feederbw german low voltage feeder electricity and weather data

description: The FeederBW team publishes real electricity measurements from 200 low-voltage distribution feeders in Baden-Württemberg, Germany. The current Zenodo release has grouped measurement ZIP files, a feeder metadata CSV and a weather Parquet file. The article and companion README describe one-minute active and reactive power, voltage and phase-current information over April 2023 to March 2025, with weather at hourly resolution. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. These traces can calibrate load diversity and low-carbon-technology integration in distribution-grid studies using a separate model such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that one utility's sampled feeders do not represent all German networks. Metadata changes in PV, heat-pump and charger installations need time alignment with measured demand. The own current Zenodo metadata and manifest were read without downloading values or checking missing intervals. The analysis code is a separate GitHub resource.
